reviews.text:
Thank you for providing vaccinations for my two dogs!

The service was very polite and prompt, and I plan to use your services again in the future.

Thank you again!
The teachers and everyone else are very kind.

Since moving to the neighborhood, we've been going there every month. We get medication for ticks and other ailments, and they check things we might not notice ourselves outside of major checkups. It also includes nail trimming and paw pad trimming, so they're a great help to us as first-time dog owners.

The doctor is kind and thorough during examinations.

He's incredibly caring and attentive.

The clear explanations of treatment methods are another reason I continue to visit this clinic.

Since aftercare is included in the treatment, I ask them to trim my pet's nails and perform anal gland expression each time.
They are very kind and helpful. My cat is happy to receive Churu treats while we wait.
The doctors and nurses are all very kind and always respond quickly, which is a great help.

I always rely on your services, mainly for grooming!

The doctors are very kind, and I appreciate that they quickly prescribe effective medication whenever there's a problem!

I look forward to continuing to rely on your services!

I'd been there a few times before and was thinking of going again, but it seems the doctor has changed.
It's a hospital where the doctors change all the time 😭
The first doctor, the one with glasses, was the most thorough and caring!
But the second doctor, the one with the narrow eyes, was the worst 😒
And then that doctor left too, and now there's a new doctor...?
And when I tried to make an appointment, it turns out they're only open 3 days a week? (Sorry if I'm wrong)
This means I can't just go there quickly if something happens... I thought, and since the main hospital in Harajuku is close to my house, I was thinking of going there, but when I checked their website, I was surprised to find out that the hospitals in Sangenjaya and Hatagaya have also been closed since September 😥
I move a lot.
At first, I thought it was reassuring that there were so many options, so I wouldn't have to worry about moving, but are they even running a proper hospital...?
In the end, I went back to my original doctor, even though it's a bit far 😭

The vet and the female staff were both very kind, and I got the impression that they really love animals. I felt completely at ease leaving both of my dogs in their care. I went in because they had developed matted fur, but they also trimmed their nails and cleaned their ears, and I also asked them to get their vaccinations done at the same time. I'm very satisfied! I look forward to continuing to use their services in the future *⸜(* ॑꒳ ॑* )⸝* The vet is also quite handsome, so I actually look forward to going there...lol

This is without a doubt the best veterinary hospital in the Yotsuya area. The doctors are very kind, knowledgeable, and considerate to the patient. 

They recommended medications, evidence-backed supplements, and delicious kidney food that other clinics hadn't even suggested, and they've helped my elderly cat regain its appetite and energy. Their decisions are rational and concise, and their explanations are thorough, so I'm completely satisfied. They also offer advice via LINE, which gives me peace of mind. I want to tell all the cats in Yotsuya that this hospital is great...

I've visited several veterinary hospitals, and while many of them have left me questioning their knowledge and attitude, this is a very honest, conscientious hospital and doctor who makes rational decisions, so I can trust them.

This is a wonderful hospital. Everything is perfect: the careful examinations, the reasonable fees, and the cleanliness of the hospital. Above all, the director, Mr. Okita, and the nurses are very kind and considerate to both pets and owners. I'm so blessed to have such a wonderful hospital so close to my home! Even though it's a little far from home, I think it's worth choosing here.

I recently came to get my cat vaccinated.
They provided free routine care and carefully examined any concerns I had, but while their website says cat vaccinations cost 5,500 yen, it actually cost 8,250 yen.

They said they hadn't updated their website in time, so I'm waiting for them to do so, but the price has remained the same at 5,500 yen, so I thought I'd write this here to let everyone know.

Other than the price, this is a perfect veterinary hospital.

The doctor's explanations are always very thorough. He takes his time and answers my questions in an easy-to-understand way.
I always feel reassured because he examines the whole picture, not just my current symptoms. The doctor is a little far from my home, but he is so considerate that I think it's worth going, even if it means taking a walk.
Payment is also smooth as you register in advance.

We recently welcomed our first dog into our home and have been taking care of him here. The doctors and nurses are very kind, and our dog never gets upset during visits, so it's a hospital we can go to with peace of mind. We plan to continue using their services for things like neutering in the future!

It was my first visit, but they examined my cat very carefully, and she was very well-behaved.

I was very pleased to learn that follow-up visits include nail trimming, paw pad trimming, anal gland expression, and ear cleaning. I'm glad they offered these services even on my first visit.
The doctor was very kind to my child and examined him well. Thank you for your careful treatment!

Both of my dogs are being cared for here.

The doctor and staff are all very kind and friendly, making it a clinic where I can entrust my pets with complete peace of mind.

I chose this clinic because it was the closest to my home and they were able to accommodate my last-minute appointment. The doctors were very kind and attentive when I asked about my concerns, and I would definitely like to use their services again. My dog ​​was in a good mood throughout the visit!


Revisited in January 2025.

It had been a while since my last visit, but my beloved dog was as excited as ever! He loves the place so much that he peeks in every time we pass by on our walks, wondering if everyone is there.

The doctors were as kind as ever. They handle even the smallest things carefully, and you can really feel their deep love for animals.

The facility is clean and meticulously maintained; it's a hospital I want to continue taking my dog ​​to for a long time!

They have a waiting room specifically for cats, which is very reassuring for someone like me who owns a timid cat. The kindness towards animals is evident in the words of the veterinarian and nurses, a stark contrast to hospitals that just want to finish treatment as quickly as possible. I also appreciate that they follow up with aftercare inquiries.

I visited for my rescued cat's first vet visit.

Since my cat isn't used to people, I was very relieved that they prioritized the cat's mental well-being, as they understood it must be stressful for her. Thank you.

I'm so glad there's a trustworthy vet in the neighborhood! I'll definitely rely on you again if anything comes up.

I recently visited this clinic for the first time, having been referred by a neighbor, regarding a tick infestation in my dog.

The doctor and staff were not only very conscientious, but they also listened attentively to my concerns while providing advice, demonstrating great enthusiasm and technical skill. I felt completely at ease in this hospital.

In addition to Peco Yotsuya, the Peco Group has branches in Higashi-Shinjuku, Kagurazaka, Harajuku, and Sangenjaya, and I was reassured knowing that my medical records would be shared across clinics if needed. They also offer support via LINE and online booking.

I am grateful to the doctor and staff for their wide range of services and kind, courteous care.

Dear Zheng Qifei,
Thank you for visiting us.
We will continue to strive to improve ourselves so that we can provide you with even greater satisfaction.
Please feel free to ask us any questions you may have.
The reception and examination staff were polite and kind.
Just as we got our puppy, we received an advertisement at home. After researching it, it seemed very good, so we decided to use their services. …

Both the doctor and nurse were kind and talked a lot while administering the vaccine. 
I didn't even notice he'd been vaccinated because I was still feeding him chewy …

I visited this clinic on the recommendation of a fellow dog walker.

Both the head veterinarian and the nurses listened carefully to my dog's …

I made a last-minute appointment for a vaccination, but the doctor and nurses were very kind and accommodating, and my dog ​​seemed to enjoy walking around the clinic the whole time.☺ Since it's nearby, I'll definitely be coming back again in the future!

It was my first time at this veterinary clinic, so I was very anxious, but the doctor and nurses were very friendly, and I felt at ease leaving my cat in their care. There were also treats in the waiting room, which helped both my cat and me relax. I plan to continue bringing my cat here in the future.
I'm glad they examined me so carefully and found out about the illness before it got worse. …
